# Spuro 0.1.0

First read-only preservation-risk scanner release: recursive repository/worktree
inventory, dirty and conflicted state, upstream analysis, stashes and weak history,
exact/tree/patch equivalence, versioned JSON, and optional GitWell/stalewood adapters.

Requires native Git. External analyzers are not bundled. This release performs no
cleanup or rescue operations. Review diagnostics and documented coverage limits
before making preservation decisions. See README and docs/maturity.md.

Archives include all three executables for Linux, macOS, and Windows on amd64/arm64.
Verify downloads against SHA256SUMS. No squash or semantic equivalence is claimed.
